page.title: Civilian Economy
page.t: A public delivery hub serving the sector's civilian population. Construction is funded by the planetary economy. Once completed, it purchases goods to maintain civilian reserves.
Testing shortcut: invokes native instant build completion. May bypass construction materials and time. Reopen this menu for the next module.

Civilian Economy: this save contains the old energy-only prototype. Load a save from before installing Civilian Economy to test leveling. No migration or additional hub was created.

Create an ownerless civilian hub with a fixed population of 5 billion. Automatically finish its initial construction after a valid layout is ready. Use an Argon profile if this sector has no valid civilian profile. Placement may take time.
Show civilian hub testing actions in the right-click menu. Disabled by default. Settings are stored in this save.

Scale civilian consumption and purchase targets. 0.1 means 10% of normal demand; 1.0 is normal; 10.0 means ten times normal demand. Existing reserves and trades are preserved. Construction materials are unaffected.

Scale the supplied time required to reach the next level. 0.1 requires one tenth of normal time; 1.0 is normal; 10.0 requires ten times normal time. Earned growth is preserved. Construction time is unaffected.
Show ticker and logbook messages for civilian sales-tax income. Tax is still paid when messages are disabled. Enabled by default.
Percentage of completed civilian purchases paid as extra tax income in player-owned sectors. 0 disables tax income; default is 15%. Seller payments are unaffected.
